_meanings:
.²1 Slave, servant in general; {#gfhakarmadAsAH#} <ls>Bh. 1. 1</ls>; {#gfha˚, karma˚#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²2 A fisherman; {#nizAdo mArgavaM sUte dAsaM nOkarmajIvinam#} <ls>Ms. 10. 34</ls>.
.²3 A Śūdra, a man of the fourth caste.
.²4 A knowing man, one who knows the universal spirit.
.²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Vṛtrāsura.
.²6 A demon.
.²7 A savage, barbarian (<ab>opp.</ab> {#Arya#}).
.²8 A worthy recipient ({#dAnapAtra#}).
.²9 A word added to the name of Śūdra; <ab>cf.</ab> {#gupta#}.

‘a slave of a slave’, the humblest of the servants;
 (sometimes used by the speaker as a mark of humility).
